integrity: Complete proof by induction and a four-case argument; an exact exhaustive small-graph certificate is independently executable. Finite testing is not used as proof of claims over infinite families. Originality is assessed against inspected literature with residual priority risk.
scientific_limitations: The minimal order seven is proved only for q=3 among connected unicyclic graphs. General q>=3 admits a 2q+1 obstruction without a minimality assertion; the result does not address directed or weighted graphs, heterogeneous responses, best-response dynamics, or welfare.
title: Tree universality and a sharp unicyclic obstruction for picky public-goods equilibria
